name: Consistent elaboration with respect to states
description: Exercise 4.72: given F ∈ FNS(SZ1, 1TO1, 𝒫S) with pairwise disjoint images and a choice function CHS ∈ CHF(S), the system Z2 on SZ2 = ∪RNG(F) with NZ2(x,p) = CHS(F(NZ1(HS(x),p))) and RZ2(x) = RZ1(HS(x)) satisfies Z2 ∈ DSYSTEMS, #SZ2 ≥ #SZ1 and Z1 = HIMSY(Z2, HS, HI, HO).

elements.text: The data F: a family of pairwise disjoint nonempty subsets of S indexed by the states of Z1.
If x1 ≠ x2 then F(x1) ∩ F(x2) = ∅.
F is automatically 1TO1: distinct states have disjoint nonempty blocks.
HS sends a point of SZ2 to the unique state of Z1 whose block contains it.
Z2 = (SZ2, IZ1, OZ1, NZ2, RZ2) with NZ2(x,p) = CHS(F(NZ1(HS(x),p))) and RZ2(x) = RZ1(HS(x)).
The chosen next state lies in the block named by NZ1, so HS intertwines the transitions.
Z2 ∈ DSYSTEMS, #SZ2 ≥ #SZ1 and Z1 = HIMSY(Z2, HS, ID(IZ2), ID(OZ2)).
